notes.title: How to use Remote Play Togather
notes.notes:
We have received many questions about how to use Remote Play Togather from China.

Steam has banned Remote Play Togather in China, so we have to use tools like UU JiaSuQi.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36541602/3775542b984d82bdd7160162c3f4a7c2ba2400cc.jpg[/img]

When you and your friend both have triggered this, you can see the invite button from your friend list.

New UU JiaSuQi users can enjoy 1 hour free experience！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36541602/4bcca5726618c429e48fec9737f2118ae916706c.gif[/img]

Really hope you can enjoy this!
